newsitem.title: JAPAN: Yaohan Japan shares fall on restructuring plans.
newsitem.headline: Yaohan Japan shares fall on restructuring plans.

text.p: Shares of Yaohan Japan Corp fell in the Tuesday morning session, depressed by the restructuring plans the supermarket operator announced late on Monday, brokers said.
At 0103 GMT, the shares were down 30 yen at 440 yen.
"The extent of the losses which will come about as a result of the restructuring is unknown, but it's certain to hurt the firm's earnings," a trader at a second-tier brokerage said.
Yaohan said on Monday that the Yaohan retailing group would slim down its overseas operations, closing down a store in Singapore next June and selling shares in its Malaysian subsidiary.
It added that it was freezing or postponing plans to open new outlets in Japan, where it now has 135 stores.
